title: Illing Chef
style: hip hop funk, 96 BPM, comedic angry energy, kitchen metaphors, AI failure theme treated as culinary disaster, punchy horns, male vocal furious but rhythmic, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
This AI is RAW
Get it out of my kitchen
The output is undercooked
And nobody's listening

Hallucinated data — served cold
Confident wrong answer — three days old
Citation doesn't exist — on the plate
This is NOT how you generate

[CHORUS]
Illing — illing — ILLING
This AI is not done
Illing — illing — ILLING
Send it back — everyone
Illing — illing — ILLING
The kitchen is on fire
Illing — illing — ILLING
Take it higher — HIGHER

[VERSE 2]
You gave it a contract to review
It hallucinated clause twenty-two
You gave it a diagnosis to suggest
It invented a drug — pass the test

RAW! Not done! Back it goes!
Log the incident — everybody knows
The bot got overconfident — again
CoreyAI logged it — amen

[BRIDGE — spoken with fury]
Do you know what this IS?
This is a SEV2 on a plate.
GET IT OUT OF MY KITCHEN.

[FINAL CHORUS]
Illing — illing — ILLING
Log it and move on
Illing — illing — ILLING
Before the damage is done

[OUTRO]
Illing.
Always illing.
Never chilling.
Not today.
